method: Seed-matched, complete-world comparisons; 50,000 paired percentile-bootstrap samples. On-time table values are unweighted means over matched weeks. Development CIs are not independent production guarantees; historical runs do not all have per-run source fingerprints.

pricing.cohort: 24 paired development weeks: 12 historical stress + 12 new

hiring.cohort: The same 24 paired development weeks as pricing

combined.cohort: Same 24 weeks; interaction check, not the sum of standalone effects

denoising.cohort: 53 paired weeks: 40 new + 13 historical stress; FINAL label here means the historical FINAL13

denoising_fresh.cohort: 40 new c14-* weeks, excluding the 13 stress weeks

safety.cohort: 63 common completed weeks; one baseline server failure excluded; historical FINAL14 baseline

safety_stress.cohort: One named development stress case; not a population estimate

volume.cohort: 24 previously unseen screening weeks; failed confirmation gate

pairing.cohort: 24 paired stress/development weeks; historical FINAL13 baseline

final_result.source: Official Spread final, snapshot, score, events, reveal and public leaderboard; read-only
final_result.display_note: With no won orders, the API's raw onTimeShare=1 is not a meaningful delivery rate.

scale.note: Seed labels are reused across policies. Exposure intervals are not independent orders. These are simulator/model scales, not Bahn's production throughput.
